descriptionZhs: 获得{Block:diff()}点格挡。然后进入隐匿状态。
descriptionEng: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Then enter the Hidden State.

descriptionZhs: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。然后进入开豪状态。
descriptionEng: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Then enter Hao Mode.

descriptionZhs: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。若你处于隐匿状态，获得{Block:diff()}点格挡。
descriptionEng: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you are in the Hidden State, gain {Block:diff()} Block.

descriptionZhs: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。若你处于开豪状态，给予{WeakPower:diff()}层虚弱。
descriptionEng: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you are in Hao Mode, apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak.

descriptionZhs: 获得{Block:diff()}点格挡。若你处于隐匿状态，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。选择一张手牌，本回合保留。
descriptionEng: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you are in the Hidden State, draw {Cards:diff()} card. Choose a card in your Hand to Retain this turn.

descriptionZhs: 切换到另一状态（尚无状态时进入隐匿状态）。抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
descriptionEng: Switch to the other state (enter Hidden State if you have none). Draw {Cards:diff()} card.

descriptionZhs: 抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。将一张手牌放到抽牌堆顶。若你处于隐匿状态，获得{Block:diff()}点格挡。
descriptionEng: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Put a card from your Hand on top of your Draw Pile. If you are in the Hidden State, gain {Block:diff()} Block.

descriptionZhs: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害{Repeat:diff()}次。然后进入开豪状态。
descriptionEng: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times. Then enter Hao Mode.

descriptionZhs: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。然后进入隐匿状态。
descriptionEng: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Then enter the Hidden State.

descriptionZhs: 每回合首次在隐匿状态与开豪状态之间切换时，抽{DualLifePower:diff()}张牌。
descriptionEng: The first time each turn you switch between Hidden State and Hao Mode, draw {DualLifePower:diff()} card.

descriptionZhs: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。隐匿状态：获得{Block:diff()}点格挡。开豪状态：改为造成两次伤害。
descriptionEng: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Hidden State: gain {Block:diff()} Block. Hao Mode: deal the damage twice instead.

descriptionZhs: 消耗一张手牌。若做到了，获得{Energy:diff()}点能量，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。然后切换到另一状态（尚无状态时进入隐匿状态）。
descriptionEng: Exhaust a card from your Hand. If you do, gain {Energy:diff()} Energy and draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Then switch to the other state (enter Hidden State if you have none).

descriptionZhs: 造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害。若本回合上一张牌是技能，此数值包含{ExtraDamage:diff()}点额外伤害。
descriptionEng: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. If your previous card this turn was a Skill, this value includes {ExtraDamage:diff()} bonus damage.
upgradeSummary: 基础伤害6→9；满足技能→攻击时总伤害10→13。

descriptionZhs: 自己的回合内，每次获得或失去豪意值时，获得{RhythmPower:diff()}点格挡。
descriptionEng: During your turn, whenever you gain or lose Hao, gain {RhythmPower:diff()} Block.
upgradeSummary: 每次触发格挡2→3；持续能力，仅自己的回合触发，无次数上限。

descriptionZhs: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。对自身施加{WeakPower:diff()}层虚弱。
descriptionEng: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak to yourself.

descriptionZhs: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。

theme: 群聊入口、现有串衍生牌
descriptionZhs: 获得{Block:diff()}点格挡。将1张串加入你的手牌。
descriptionEng: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Add 1 Chuan to your hand.
